rows.question: 油价变化为什么会影响家庭的食品和运输成本？
rows.answer: 油价上涨不只影响加油：燃油变贵会推高运输成本，能源和化肥成本也会进入食品生产，因而买菜和送货都可能变贵。

rows.question: Why do oil costs affect household food and transport?
rows.answer: Oil affects more than the fuel bill: dearer fuel raises transport costs, while energy and fertilizer costs enter food production. Groceries and deliveries can therefore become more expensive.
